SEN.note: Only a digital health bill is mentioned, not a general data protection law.

facts.fact: APS reports the patient record (DPI) was deployed as a pilot at Abass Ndao and Thierno Birahim Ndao hospitals, the HLM Fass health post and the Khadim Rassoul health centre.
APS reports the pilot of the patient record covers a health centre and a health post, beside two hospitals.
APS reports the PAENS project plans to extend the patient record to six more regions from 2025, at the Prime Minister's request.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Social Action

facts.fact: APS reports the health ministry held a validation workshop on 28 April 2025 on the digital health policy framework, attended by the private sector and health actors as well as WHO, World Bank and National Assembly representatives.
